title: Pink Sorority Girl Halloween Costume
intro: The easiest costume of the season. A pastel pink cropped hoodie, a pleated pink tennis skirt with pockets, pink and white striped knee socks, pink platform high tops and a zip canvas tote big enough for snacks and a phone charger. It reads as a costume at the party and as an outfit on Saturday morning, which is the whole trick. Nothing here is uncomfortable, nothing needs ironing, and every piece goes back into fall weekend rotation the day after.

items.name: Pink pleated tennis skirt with pockets
Pink and white striped knee high tube socks
Pink platform canvas high top sneakers
Pink canvas tote bag with zipper
